method: Searched both publisher domains for every current candidate, including certified write-ins and name variants. Verified titles, bylines, mentions, and original publication dates using publisher pages, search-indexed publisher text, print PDFs, or explicitly identified publisher syndications. This is a verified search result set, not a claim to exhaust either archive.
notes: Only metadata and associations are stored, not article text.
Publication dates use original publisher dates rather than update or syndication dates.
Fetched-on dates record verification of the article or link/metadata, including indexed or syndicated evidence where original access was restricted.
The Melody homepage currently redirects to macon.com, but individual archive URLs and PDFs remain indexed.
Collective credits are not turned into person records; named contributors receive Contributor roles.

excluded_leads.reason: Video shell did not expose enough date/byline metadata to verify an article record.
Accessible syndicated text discusses the Senate runoff but does not name either current candidate.
Could not verify a named candidate mention from accessible text.
